name: load
description: Pace Claude's heavy work to the machine it runs on, with configurable hard caps

caps.title: Hard caps
caps.description: pool:limit:regex entries. A Bash command matching the regex is refused while `limit` processes matching its pool already run. Entries sharing a pool share its limit. Empty caps nothing.

remind.title: Remind at load per core
remind.description: Remind the model to pace heavy work once the load average per core reaches this, or under memory pressure. 0 turns reminders off.

warn.title: Warn at load per core
warn.description: Tell the model to start no heavy work it doesn't need once the load average per core reaches this, or under critical memory pressure. 0 leaves only memory pressure.

refuse.title: Refuse above load per core
refuse.description: Refuse capped commands while the load average per core is above this. 0 turns it off.
